note: Screened out of data/registers/barcelona-ail.json (Ajuntament de Barcelona, Arbres d'interes local, CC BY 4.0, 208 entries) during the deepening pass that produced data/research/barcelona-extra.json. Not rendered anywhere. leads = trees that failed only on our evidence bar or on the count, and are the raw material if Barcelona grows further. blocked = trees that must never ship whatever happens later, each with its reason. Extended 2026-08-05 by the second deepening pass (data/research/barcelona-extra-2.json, the Montjuic walk): ten leads and five blocked entries added from the Sants-Montjuic screen, and the Lagunaria and the Eritrina of the Teatre Grec removed from leads because they published as bcn_017 and bcn_019. Extended 2026-08-06 by the Barcelona deepen verification pass: the Pedralbes/Torre Girona and Vil.la Amelia clusters (bcn_023 to bcn_032) verified and delivered to data/research/barcelona-verified.json, none blocked. One incidental find (Tarongers de Louisiana, Torre Girona) added to leads, undated and unjudged for collectibility. Extended 2026-08-08 by a verification pass on the five undated Gracia/Park Guell-adjacent candidates: the Llentiscle de l'Hort de l'Avi verified and delivered to data/research/barcelona-verified.json as bcn_033 (public access path into Park Guell's free wooded perimeter, second source bcnsostenible.cat). The combined four-tree lead entry below is superseded by the three entries that follow it, split out with what this pass found. Two of the remaining three moved to blocked (Ficus de Mysore, Xiprer del carrer Betlem); two stay leads with access now the open question rather than the date (Garrofer and Pebrer bord del carrer Maignon). Extended 2026-08-29: a verify claim on the Pedralbes/Sarria cluster re-verified bcn_023/024/025 under new ids (bcn_056/057/058) without checking passcheck.py first; folded into blocked as duplicates. One genuine new find survived from the same pass, the Osage Oranges of the Torre Girona Gardens (bcn_059), a distinct catalogued item (register_id 99400680106) in the same garden as the already-published bcn_026/027/028, different species, not a duplicate. Extended 2026-11-01: eight leads in the Jardi Botanic Historic named by the garden's friends' association in a mail (ginkgo pair, olive, Atlas cedars, Balearic box, carob, American elms, planes, Kentucky coffee tree); coordinates are the sector only. The same mail also named smaller specimens (Pistacia lentiscus, Pistacia atlantica, Vitex agnus-castus, Teline, Ephedra altissima, Celtis australis, Vachellia caven) and pointed at the newer Jardi Botanic de Barcelona. 2026-11-03: the Amics del Jardi Botanic sent 26 photographs and two booklets (AMB guide 2009, itinerary 2017); what did not ship is here with the file names. One file, 'Fraxinus angustifolia2.jpg', is a Google Street View screenshot and was not used.

leads.name: Freixe de fulla estreta del Jardi Botanic Historic
leads.why: DUPLICATE, found 2026-08-16: 18m from bcn_021 (Narrow-Leaved Ash, Fraxinus angustifolia), same species, same ravine. Very likely the same physical tree under the Generalitat's 2025 monumental designation rather than a fourth distinct specimen; leave for a pass that can establish on the ground whether it is genuinely a second tree. Original note: Count, not quality. This and the Acer below are the two remaining trees of the four the Catalan government declared monumental in April 2025, all four in the Sot de l'Estany ravine. We already publish the other two (bcn_005, bcn_006) and the city intro already tells the reader there are four. Adding both would put four of sixteen Barcelona entries inside one ravine behind one paid gate. Strong candidates the day the page can carry them, and the pair completes a claim the page already makes.
leads.register_notes: No planting year recorded. 29 m tall, girth 2.5 m, crown 15 m. Catalogued 2015.

Original note: Same as above: the fourth monumental tree of the Sot de l'Estany, held back on count rather than merit. Register gives no planting year ('Per determinar'), so it would ship flagged.
leads.register_notes: 30 m tall, girth 1.4 m, crown 12 m. Catalogued 2015.

leads.name: Garrofer del carrer Maignon
leads.why: Date is no longer the only open question: existence and species now have two sources (register 99400680090 plus beteve.cat's 2021 press coverage of the 40-tree AIL designation), but access is unconfirmed and leans against. The ajuntament's own description says the carob grows out of a roughly 2m wall 'that limits the internal road where cars circulate and the part of the garden at a higher level', part of an unnamed walled 'complex' at Carrer de Maignon 27. Overpass shows an underground public car park ('Parking Esperanca i Park Guell') and Hospital de l'Esperanca roughly 150m away, both consistent with an internal service road rather than a public street frontage. Femgracia's street directory lists Carrer de Maignon itself as a normal commercial street, which does not resolve whether number 27 is a private courtyard off it. A future pass should either find a description that confirms public access (or a street-view/photo showing the wall from the public pavement) or move this to blocked.
leads.register_notes: Girth 1.84m, height 7m, crown 17m. Catalogued 2021. Ownership field blank in the register import.

leads.name: Pebrer bord del carrer Maignon
leads.why: Same garden as the Garrofer above, 41m away, same access question and same conclusion: register plus beteve.cat's 2021 press piece give two sources for existence and species, but not for public access. Girth of 4.34m is large for the species; plausible for a mature multi-stemmed Schinus molle but worth a sanity check against a photo before shipping. Resolve alongside the Garrofer, they are one site.
leads.register_notes: Girth 4.34m, height 10m, crown 12m. Catalogued 2021. Ownership field blank in the register import.

leads.name: Arbres de l'amor de la placa Joanic
leads.why: 1956, 70 years. A Judas tree's April flowering would make a strong best_time, and it is 330 m from bcn_001, but it is too young. [RESOLVED 2026-08-28, delivered as bcn_054]

leads.name: The Pedralbes cluster: Jardins del Palau Reial de Pedralbes and Jardins de la Torre Girona
leads.species: Pinus pinea; Cedrus deodara; Tetraclinis articulata; Brachychiton populneus; Maclura pomifera; Pinus halepensis
leads.why: Not evaluated in this pass, and recorded here because it is the strongest untouched cluster in the city. Eight register entries lie inside 400 m of each other across the Palau Reial gardens, the Torre Girona gardens and the Pavellons Guell with Gaudi's dragon gate, all in one walk, 1.2 km west of bcn_007. A future pass should take this as a single unit rather than tree by tree, and must check the access of each: the Palau Reial gardens are public, Torre Girona sits on the UPC campus, and the Pavellons Guell keep visiting hours.
leads.register_notes: OSM nodes 4506752018, 4532330334, 4506742261, 4506743003, 4506753110 confirm several of these positions.

leads.name: The Vil-la Amelia and Sarria cluster
leads.species: Schinus molle; Phoenix canariensis; Platanus x acerifolia; Eucalyptus globulus
leads.why: Four register entries inside one public Sarria garden, 900 m from the Pedralbes cluster above. Not evaluated this pass. The eucalyptus and the plane are single-unit; the palms are a group and would need the collectible-point test.

leads.name: Lledoner de la Fundacio Munoz Ramonet
leads.why: Access unverified. The Munoz Ramonet gardens passed to the city and open to the public on a limited schedule; that needs confirming before this counts as publicly accessible. Undated in the candidate list.

leads.name: Figuera de la Facultat de Dret
leads.why: On the university law faculty grounds. The campus is open in practice but the register does not say so, and the entry is undated. Sits inside the Pedralbes cluster above, so resolve it with that pass.

leads.name: Huingan del carrer Joaquim Blume
leads.why: Species dispute, and it is the only thing holding this back. The city register says Schinus longifolia, an Argentine species; OSM node 4506714524, surveyed from the same catalogue, says Schinus polygamus; and huingan, the common name the city itself uses, is the Chilean name for S. polygama. With the build now failing on species naming, shipping a tree under a contested binomial is not worth it. Everything else is fine: 1916, public, on the Montjuic walk 200 m from the Teatre Grec gardens, and the municipal record calls it a botanical rarity with only one other specimen in the whole city, larger, in the Jardi d'Aclimatacio. Resolve the species with one look at the leaves in a photograph and this ships.
leads.register_notes: Girth 1.6 m, 8 m tall, crown 9 m. Public. Pin would be confirmed: register 41.37211/2.15533 and OSM node 4506714524 are 9 m apart.
leads.held_reason: Already live as bcn_041 (The Pepper Tree of Carrer Joaquim Blume), 9 m from this lead point. (2026-10-20)

leads.name: Araucaria de l'avinguda Francesc Ferrer i Guardia
leads.why: 1920 and 24 m tall, which would make it a good sixth stop on the Montjuic walk, but it has no second source of any kind. It is a recent catalogue entry with no bcnsostenible page, no guia.barcelona page, no OSM node within 400 m and an empty ownership field, so neither the age, the position nor the public access can be corroborated. Everything rests on one line in the open data file. UPDATE 2026-08-27: a second source now exists, beteve.cat's 31 May 2024 article on Barcelona's 12 newly protected trees names this exact tree ('Araucaria - Avinguda de Francesc Ferrer i Guardia, 18'). Still not shipped: the address falls within a 12-36 building-complex range (Nominatim, 2026-08-27) in the Magoria/Font de la Guatlla area near Placa Espanya, and whether the tree stands on the public avenue sidewalk or inside a private courtyard of that complex could not be confirmed this pass. Resolve the access question before shipping.
leads.register_notes: Girth 2 m, 24 m tall, crown 14 m. Ownership field blank.

leads.name: Grevillea dels jardins dels Drets Humans

Undated, which is the only reason it is here, and it sits 1.4 km south of the botanical garden in La Marina de Port, off the Montjuic walk. A silky oak that size would carry a page on its own if a date or a second source turns up. [RESOLVED 2026-08-27, delivered as bcn_047]
leads.register_notes: Crown 27 m. Ownership Public. Jardins dels Drets Humans.

leads.name: Tarongers de Louisiana dels jardins de la Torre Girona
leads.why: Incidental find while verifying the Torre Girona cluster (2026-08-06 Barcelona deepen pass): a 14-unit register entry in the same garden as bcn_026/027/028, but the register gives no planting year and no ownership field, and no independent source was checked this pass. Also a third grove entry in one small garden alongside the pines already delivered, so it would need its own collectibility judgement before it ships.
leads.register_notes: Girth 1.9m, height 8m, crown 6m, catalogued 2021. Age Per determinar in the register.

leads.name: Holm oak of the Montnegre-Corredor park (exact tree unidentified)
leads.why: Spotted by Hidde on Instagram 2026-08-13: a very large low-branching holm oak in the Parc del Montnegre i el Corredor, climbable, photographed with a person standing in the crown. Not researched yet and NOT a Barcelona city tree: the park centre is about 41 km from the city, well past the day-trip boundary of roughly 30 minutes by public transport, so it belongs to a future page for Mataro, Sant Celoni or the park itself rather than to Barcelona. Catalonia's monumental-tree register would name it in one query but is BLOCKED on licence (its metadata says only otherRestrictions and the WFS declares no permission), which is what the drafts/catalonia-permission.md letter asks for. The Instagram photograph itself is unusable under hard rule 4, no open licence. What a future pass needs: the tree's own name, whether it is one of the park's named alzines, and a source that is not social media.

leads.name: Ginkgos del Jardi Botanic Historic (male and female)
leads.why: Named in a mail of 2026-11-01 from the friends' association of the Jardi Botanic Historic (an answer to our photo ask of 2026-10-29), which also said it would look for photographs. Not in data/registers/barcelona-ail.json. Sot de l'Estany. 'Two good specimens, a male and a female.' An ensemble only if they stand together; needs a spot. Resolved 2026-11-03: the female went live as bcn_060 from their photographs and booklets. The two males in the Sot de l'Estany (itinerary 2017: 25 years, 18 m, the marked one) stay unpublished: young.

leads.name: Cedres de l'Atles del Jardi Botanic Historic

leads.name: Acacia caven del Jardi Botanic Historic
leads.why: One of the two acacias flanking the garden gate. Planted 1974 by Eugeni Sierra from seed collected in Chile (AMB guide 2009; itinerary 2017: 3 m, 43 years in 2017). Young and small, so a story rather than a size; the itinerary's first stop. Photograph from the Amics del Jardi Botanic (mail 2026-11-02, permission licence) kept in out/pere-2026-11-02/ on the Mac, file 'Acacia caven vachelia caven.jpeg'; it is theirs to use on the page when the lead ships. The photograph shows the crown in full yellow flower against the sky, striking.

leads.name: Aromer (Acacia farnesiana) del Jardi Botanic Historic
leads.why: The other acacia at the gate, from Central America; the 2009 guide tells its history (described by Tobia Aldini in the Farnese gardens in Rome in the early 1600s). No size given. Photograph from the Amics del Jardi Botanic (mail 2026-11-02, permission licence) kept in out/pere-2026-11-02/ on the Mac, file 'Acacia farnesiana.jpg'; it is theirs to use on the page when the lead ships. Poor photograph (611 px, crown against white sky), not usable as a lead picture.

leads.name: Faig del Jardi Botanic Historic
leads.why: A beech in a Mediterranean quarry pit, above the big hazel on the way up from the cascade (AMB guide 2009); itinerary 2017: 14 m, 90 years. The southernmost beeches in Iberia are at the Ports de Tortosa, so one in Barcelona is a curiosity. Worth a page once a spot and a measurement exist. Photograph from the Amics del Jardi Botanic (mail 2026-11-02, permission licence) kept in out/pere-2026-11-02/ on the Mac, file 'Fagus sylvatica.jpg'; it is theirs to use on the page when the lead ships. Photograph: whole tree, slender, behind a fan palm, usable.

leads.name: Efedra gegant del Jardi Botanic Historic
leads.why: Not a tree: a male liana of a primitive gymnosperm genus, planted by Pius Font i Quer in the 1930s, that climbs its neighbours until they break and has brought down three large pines (AMB guide 2009; itinerary 2017: 20 m, 90 years). The garden's best story and a possible ensemble point with the hazel and the beech; kept as a lead because the product counts trees. Photograph from the Amics del Jardi Botanic (mail 2026-11-02, permission licence) kept in out/pere-2026-11-02/ on the Mac, file 'Ephedra altissima.jpg'; it is theirs to use on the page when the lead ships. Photograph: a mound of green stems under the fan palms, usable.

leads.name: Margallo del Jardi Botanic Historic
leads.why: A clump of Europe's native fan palm, itinerary 2017: 3 m, 80 years, with a label. Small; a lead for a palms angle only. Photograph from the Amics del Jardi Botanic (mail 2026-11-02, permission licence) kept in out/pere-2026-11-02/ on the Mac, file 'Chamaerops humilis.jpg'; it is theirs to use on the page when the lead ships.

leads.name: Palmera de Canaries del Jardi Botanic Historic

An ensemble with one place to stand; not a tree. Photograph from the Amics del Jardi Botanic (mail 2026-11-02, permission licence) kept in out/pere-2026-11-02/ on the Mac, file 'Cycas revoluta.jpg'; it is theirs to use on the page when the lead ships. Photograph: the whole group, usable.

Photograph from the Amics del Jardi Botanic (mail 2026-11-02, permission licence) kept in out/pere-2026-11-02/ on the Mac, file 'Pistacia lentiscus.jpg'; it is theirs to use on the page when the lead ships.

Photograph from the Amics del Jardi Botanic (mail 2026-11-02, permission licence) kept in out/pere-2026-11-02/ on the Mac, file 'Teline osmariensis.jpg'; it is theirs to use on the page when the lead ships.

blocked.name: Ficus de Mysore del Santuari de Sant Josep de la Muntanya
blocked.why: Access unresolved and the site is sensitive enough that unresolved is a reason to hold rather than ship. Register (99400680086) plus beteve.cat's 2021 press piece on the 40-tree AIL designation give two sources for existence and species, so this is not an evidence problem. It is an access problem: Viquipedia describes the complex as a convent-asylum built around 'a central cloister serving as distribution nuclei', plus a church and a novices' residence, and states the site currently houses a reception centre for at-risk minors. The church itself keeps public hours (10:30-13:30, 16:30-19:00 daily per santuariosanjose.org) and the complex welcomes pilgrims, but nothing found places the ficus specifically in the public esplanade/staircase area rather than the cloister or residence, and sending readers looking for a specific tree inside a children's care facility is not a chance worth taking on an unconfirmed guess. Revisit only if a future pass gets the sanctuary's own confirmation that the tree stands in the area open to visitors.

blocked.name: Xiprer comu del carrer Betlem
blocked.why: Private land, not open to visitors. Register (99400680099) plus beteve.cat's 2021 press piece confirm existence and species (2.1m girth, 24m tall, catalogued 2021), but a Guia Barcelona description found in search places it explicitly 'in the front courtyard of a private four-story building' at Carrer de Betlem 55-59, alongside a plane and a tipuana. No sign this is a street tree or on any publicly accessible plot. Hard rule 10 territory: leave it out.
